Life at Peelers Yard

Connected to the city.
Rooted in character.

A place to share, retreat, meet and make your own — bringing the spirit of Ancoats into contemporary everyday living.

A neighbourhood renewed

Old stories. New chapters.

The heart of the Ancoats community was worn away through decades of land misuse and the destruction of housing. Peelers Yard looks to help bring that sense of community back.

Tim Groom Architects has drawn on Manchester’s proud tradition of terraced housing and the distinctive streetscapes of Amsterdam, interpreting these influences for a contemporary city residence.

Grade II listed features are incorporated into the development, bringing a tangible connection to the area's past.

Manchester · Ancoats

In the middle of the momentum.

Set between Ancoats and the Northern Quarter, Peelers Yard places you within Manchester’s evolving mix of independent places, city energy and neighbourhood character.

A city on your doorstep

Live close to what moves you.

Ancoats is known for its industrial heritage, independent food scene and creative spirit. The neighbouring Northern Quarter adds music, design, cafés and culture to the everyday mix.

Peelers Yard brings a residential address to this energetic part of Manchester, with the city centre close at hand.
